method_evidence.claim: Hunyuan3D-Omni accepts point clouds, voxels, bounding boxes, and skeletal pose priors as conditioning signals.
method_evidence.anchor: In addition to images, \shortname accepts point clouds, voxels, bounding boxes, and skeletal pose priors as conditioning signals

method_evidence.claim: The model unifies all signals in a single cross-modal architecture.
method_evidence.anchor: Instead of separate heads for each modality, our model unifies all signals in a single cross-modal architecture.

method_evidence.claim: Training uses a progressive, difficulty-aware sampling strategy that selects one control modality per example and biases sampling toward harder signals.
method_evidence.anchor: We train with a progressive, difficulty-aware sampling strategy that selects one control modality per example and biases sampling toward harder signals (~\eg, skeletal pose) while downweighting easier ones (~\eg, point clouds)
